description: This file contains unit tests for the Theme Toggle feature of a React application, using the Testing Library.

methods.name: renders theme toggle button with initial light theme
methods.description: Tests that the theme toggle button is initially rendered with the light theme.

methods.name: toggles theme when button is clicked
methods.description: Tests that the theme switches between light and dark modes when the toggle button is clicked.

methods.name: theme persists in document after component updates
methods.description: Tests that the theme state persists in the document even after component updates.
